review.notes: Full normalized word-level diff of all 52 extracted PDF pages against the OCR Markdown, plus code-fence balance check (3 balanced blocks). Pages 38, 41, 43 and 49 were rendered (120 dpi) and physical page 49 was additionally rendered at 300 dpi to transcribe the dropped RACE question-answer turns. All 37 printed table captions were enumerated on both sides; body prose, references and equations show only LaTeX-normalization and punctuation-spacing differences handled by the shared normalizer. Figure-internal chart text and prompt boxes embedded as images were not treated as defects. Markdown escapes such as weight\_decay render identically to the printed underscore and were left unchanged.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.41 prints 'Table 20 | An example of CMRC2018.' centered below the Heldenplatz prompt box (visually verified). The OCR embedded the box as image 7c02c063...jpg (visually confirmed to be the CMRC2018 Heldenplatz box) but dropped its caption line, so the md jumps from the CMMLU caption to the Table 21 DROP caption. The patch only inserts the printed caption text between the two image embeds without changing the embeds.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.49 (verified at 300 dpi and full-page 120 dpi) shows the printed page number 49 colliding with the third option line '- One way to learn to be a wise writer' at the bottom of the RACE box; the OCR glued the page number into the option text as a spurious '$^{49}$' superscript and merged the fourth option into the same line. The same page print also shows 'Table 33 | An example of RACE.' below the OPTIONS block, which the OCR dropped. The patch removes the page-number artifact, restores the option line break, and reinserts the caption before the TriviaQA image embed without changing any embed.
